name: Reijou Kanritou ~Seifuku Shoujo-tachi no Sakunyuu Reizokuki~
original_name: 隷嬢管理棟 ～制服少女たちの搾乳隷属記～
source:
There is a dormitory at a private school for training high-class ladies, where students are trained secretly 'To Serve Men'.
However, one of the students got pregnant during the training.
To prevent this from becoming a scandal, the pregnant student was expelled and the dormitory was shut down in fear of causing another incident. Many years passed and now the decaying building is awaiting demolition.

The protagonist, the bastard child of the accidental pregnancy, negotiates with the current principal of the school using the story he heard from his mother.
He negotiates to reopen the dormitory, and work there as a manager.
He only has one goal in mind.

To drain the slaves he has raised and taste their milk.

So the dormitory known as the 'Mistress Administration Building' has been revived by the protagonist. The building will be transformed into the 'Slave Management Building; where the sounds of schoolgirls being trained and milked will echo throughout the night.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1105082&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
一所私立学校设有一间培养高级女士的宿舍，学生们在那里接受秘密训练“为男人服务”。
然而，一名学员在培训期间怀孕了。
为了防止这件事成为丑闻，这名怀孕的学生被开除，宿舍也被关闭，以免引发另一起事件。许多年过去了，现在这座破旧的建筑正在等待拆除。

主人公，意外怀孕的私生子，用从母亲那里听到的故事与现任校长谈判。
他协商重新开放宿舍，并在那里担任经理。
他心里只有一个目标。

为了排干他养大的奴隶并品尝他们的牛奶。

于是被称为‘女主人行政楼’的宿舍就被主角复活了。该建筑将改造成“奴隶管理大楼”；女学生接受训练和挤奶的声音将在整个晚上回响。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1105082&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
